subject: general
question:
Select a suitable figure from the answer figures which would replace the question mark(?).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13077c2608fd2c26e106b090055df7bf3bf1c974e622e72ccfcd591f33c3f5ca.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 **All the given characters are moving in clockwise direction.**

Square moves:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/77a26c46b2e459d5d654471e4266af499070ce5fa966d8e896d35be9c78c3ec5.png] 

Triangle moves:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/438f00d0e2762d84c86a0869965d6bb88e1ca762c6ba5462764f5f509e01c9d6.png] 

Pentagon moves:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1812402ecbe00ce4d214c507131ed5e1cf8caa7c6465d09f585de088a0bce8b.png] 

Circle moves:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57230dcf6896f339d037fe9b451ea61986a2b3944808eead925bc3e6bc00f1c1.png] 

So, the next step will be: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d666d6bc0d68aaf959fb5142a0305b2d79cb26aa642655c94e7a91b5dfe5653.png] 

We consider the given options:

Option 1) Position of square and pentagon is wrong.

Option 2) Position of square and circle is wrong.

Option 3) Position of triangle and circle is wrong.

Option 4) The pattern matches completely.

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
